newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Noble Group offers 51 mln shares for US$0.88 each.
newsitem.headline: Noble Group offers 51 mln shares for US$0.88 each.

text.p: Hong Kong-based Noble Group said on Thursday it was offering 51.49 million shares with a par value of Hong Kong $1 at U.S.$0.88 each in its Singapore initial public offer (IPO).
Noble said in a statement it was offering 10.30 million shares to the public and 41.19 million shares by way of placement. The offer comprises 48 million new shares and 3.49 million vendor shares.

It said the IPO was expected to raise net proceeds of U.S.$39.4 million from the new shares. Of that, approximately $10 million would be used to expand the group's range of products, $10 million to acquire vessels to expand the group's shipping business, $15 million to reduce bank borrowings, and the balance to boost working capital.
Noble markets, process and transports industrial and agricultural materials.
The shares will be quoted on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore. The offer is open until March 12 and the shares will commence trading on a when-issued basis on March 14.

The company said the offer price represented an historical price-earnings ratio of 8.52 times based on net earnings per share for the financial year ended December 31, 1995, and an estimated PE of 8.4 times for the latest financial year.
